text: Build a small command-line tool that reads a fabricated CSV of library loans and prints which loans are overdue, grouped by borrower. Use only made-up sample data.
Add a dark-mode toggle to a fictional recipe-sharing website. The setting should persist between visits and respect the visitor's system preference by default.
Fix a bug in an imaginary to-do app where completed tasks reappear after the page is refreshed. Include tests that would have caught it.
